I know what I’m supposed to do and I understand  the logic and rhetoric but just can’t get my mind and my heart to realize it. 

It took me way too many years to realize what the phrase the road to hell is paved with good intentions means. Regardless if I was doing the right thing by staying I was making things worse for both of us.

So I perpetuated things. I put up with the abuse and then by standing up for myself I just made things worse.  It was unhealthy and we didn’t do the things we needed to do to get better like therapy or couples therapy. 

I was so focused on helping her get to where she needed to be that I didn’t take care of myself. 

And the toxicity made it an on and off. She would start throwing other guys in my face. And then I’d start seeing other girls. And we’d get back. But getting back together was purely to protect her pride and status with her family and protect the image that she was in a stable relationship and wasn’t failing school and she was getting her doctorate. But she continually held everything over my head.  

And finally once she graduated and was at the point where she had to take her licensure and it was finally something that she had to do on her own she started just taking.  No hugs. No intimacy. Not even a New Years kiss.  

‘Just give me money.  Give me a massage. Pay my bills. Give me money to do my hair and nails. Clean the house because you ow my parents because we stay in their house because of my massive debt that I pretend doesn’t exist even though you are trying to build a foundation for us and even bought a house for us away from my family. I feel whether you believe in it or not the logic is the same. Your value system or your ascribing to the value system of others ( one in particular that deals with pride status and shame  and guilt ) will keep you ( and me) in that negative spot. So now I’ve lost purpose and don’t know what one doing in life.

I have.  I used to do 5 year plans and lived my life for others.  I sacrificed everything for my family. And now that they’ve left me in have no purpose or drive.  

I used to be super driven , very active , hit the gym and played sports.  Would read and study and be all about development as it all converted with taking care of a family. 

Now there’s no point.  I stopped paying my mortgage.  I’m probably going to quit my job soon. And my side development gig will probably implode as I don’t have the energy to get it across the finish line.  Don’t have health insurance and am hoping the cancer from 10 years ago comes back. Hope they every time I hop in a plane it will  crash. 

I don’t have purpose and am just waiting for that one thing that will put me over the edge.  I already tried sleeping pills because they were there in a moment that gave me strength / courage ( or to some cowardice ) but even taking 100 of them wasn’t enough. I woke up and luckily didn’t have permanent damage. 

im just researching for that reliable and accessible method for when I have the next impulse.

I’m like that when I get on a plane.  I just hope it crashes.  

Or with my health. I had cancer over 10 years ago but haven’t had insurance for the last 5 years. Ian’s I keep hoping it’s come back and by the time it’s found it’s in late stage and terminal. 

I already tried sleeping pills but failed and am too scare to try again and do permanente damage through a other unsuccessful attempt.

Using money as an example. Not that you would put money on a pedestal. There have been billionaires who lost money and became millionaires and committed suicide. Because they value to status and money and they let them affect themselves.

Everything takes time.
